page: UpCloud GPU-20xCPU-256GB-3xL4 is a GPU-accelerated server instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 CPU architecture with 20 shared vCPUs and 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory allocation of 12.8 GB per core.

The server is equipped with three NVIDIA L4 GPUs based on the Ada Lovelace architecture, providing a total of 72 GB of VRAM. This instance does not include local storage, meaning external storage volumes must be attached. It includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Given the high density of GPU resources and memory relative to the shared CPU allocation, this server offers a specialized hardware profile for workloads that are heavily dependent on GPU acceleration rather than dedicated single-core CPU performance. It is designed for workloads such as machine learning inference, data science jobs, and parallel processing tasks that leverage multiple GPUs.
